tasks.title: Create API client singleton

No imports from client-resources, text, or collaborator-client

tasks.title: Create useHulyQuery and useHulyMutation hooks
tasks.description: Create useHulyQuery<T> wrapping useQuery with auto-generated query keys from ['huly', _class, hash(query), hash(options)]. Create useHulyFindOne<T>. Create useHulyCreate, useHulyUpdate, useHulyRemove mutations wrapping useMutation with query invalidation. Include stableHash utility for deterministic keys. Barrel export from src/hooks/index.ts.

Mutations invalidate matching queries on success
Hooks disabled when client not connected
TypeScript enforces query type matches Doc subtype fields

tasks.title: Create auth-client bridge connection store
tasks.description: Create Zustand useConnectionStore in src/store/connection.ts. States: disconnected, connecting, connected, error. Actions: connect(endpoint, workspaceId, token) creates HulyClient and sets singleton, disconnect() clears client, reconnect(). Barrel export from src/store/index.ts. This bridges Phase 1 auth with Phase 2 data access.
acceptanceCriteria: client property returns HulyClient after connect
disconnect() clears client and transitions to 'disconnected'
Error during connect transitions to 'error' with message
